trimming.missingBounds: Estimate geometric lateral and label the trim method
trimming.geometricFallbackParameters: Longest contiguous sampled station run with inclination >=80 degrees, at least two stations; method labelled Inclination80Estimate

geometryPrecedence.first: Validated ACTUAL survey trimmed to lateral interval
geometryPrecedence.secondInNewMexico: PLANNED directional survey trimmed to lateral interval and labelled PlannedGeometry
geometryPrecedence.fallback: Enverus wells.LateralLine; toe-back XY trim by positive reported lateral length when toe is verified
geometryPrecedence.phantom: Do not promote PHANTOM survey geometry
geometryPrecedence.reviewGeometry: Retain untrimmable fallback lines in the analytical layer with AllocationReview flags, per user preference

tcaAssignment.overlapFractionDenominator: Total selected well lateral plan-view length
tcaAssignment.noMatch: Leave TCA attributes null and flag
tcaAssignment.keyValidation: Require nonblank unique TCA_NAME in the applicable TCA source; flag violations before assignment.

fluidWindowAssignment.overlapFractionDenominator: Total selected well lateral plan-view length
fluidWindowAssignment.noMatch: Leave fluid-window attributes null and flag

calculationNullPolicy: For missing, zero, negative, nonnumeric, or nonfinite WPS, return null for both calculated fields and flag the reason. Preserve native geodatabase NULL values.

acquisition.surveyScope: API12 allowlist from included wells; broad survey downloads blocked

scope: All account-entitled North America wells; no basin/country filter
gisBasinAssignment: Longest positive analytical lateral overlap; vertical surface containment; ties flagged
wellConstraint: Y only for Horizontal or Directional trajectory with usable lateral geometry intersecting a Gugg Basin/Bench-matched TCA; all other trajectories and unmatched wells remain N
wellConstraintStatus: WelCnsStat (TEXT 6, alias Well Constraint Status) follows WellConstr and looks up EnvStatus from private Json/Config/WellConstraintStatus.Local.json; unlisted or missing statuses remain null and are reported
identity: Country plus full supplied API_UWI; never truncate Canadian UWIs
